remarks: Coveted location in Palmer Landing facing Stamford Harbor. A stylish two-bedroom townhouse with updated kitchen and baths. The kitchen has handsome wood cabinets and granite tops. Two generous bedrooms, each with their own bathroom with marble and granite finishes. A large living room with fireplace leads to a balcony with views of the harbor and westerly sunsets. This unit has a detached garage in addition to the large guest parking lot. Heat and water are including in the rent. Laundry on main level. Palmer Landing has gated entry, a sun-drenched pool, available boat slips and a boat house. A vibrant waterfront community, just minutes to the sandy West Beach, Metro North train, and Downtown Stamford. Welcome to Shippan Point.
